name: Prem Sweets
why_it_matters: Founded by Pandit Lok Nath Khajuria in 1925, this is the highway shop that put Kud on the map — the desi-ghee patisa here spawned an entire roadside marketplace of imitators. Ranked #1 dessert spot in the Patnitop area on TripAdvisor.
insider_tip: Buy a 250g box for the journey, not 500g — Kud's patisa is unusually flaky and crumbles in transit. Sundays they're open; Mondays closed. Hours 8am-9pm.
signature_address: National Highway 1A, Kud, Patnitop 182142, Jammu & Kashmir

name: Kailash Bar and Restaurant
why_it_matters: TripAdvisor's #1-ranked Patnitop restaurant — practically the only standalone (non-hotel) eatery on the Kud market stretch with consistent reviews. Reviewers flag it as the value alternative to overpriced hotel restaurants up the hill.
insider_tip: Has a coffee shop tucked below the restaurant — useful for a quick chai stop without committing to a full meal. Beer here is the cheapest in any Patnitop bar, ~₹10 over theka rates.
signature_address: National Highway 1A, Kud, Patnitop 182142, Jammu & Kashmir

name: Banana Leaf (Skyview by Empyrean)
why_it_matters: The lower-terminal restaurant at Skyview by Empyrean — the only fine-dining option in the Patnitop area, with a chef-led menu pushing Dogri and Kashmiri Pandit cuisine alongside continental sizzlers. Sanget Valley views from the terrace.
insider_tip: You don't need to be a Skyview hotel guest to dine — walk-ins from the gondola complex are accepted. Order the Dogri thali before the Indo-Chinese: it's where the kitchen has the most range.
signature_address: Skyview by Empyrean, Sanget Valley, near Patnitop, Udhampur 182142

name: Skyview Café
signature_dish: chicken tikka sizzler at the gondola lower terminal
why_it_matters: Alfresco café at the Skyview Gondola lower terminal in Sanget — the practical pre/post-ride stop with a Shivalik-range terrace. Sizzler-heavy menu sized for families breaking up the gondola queue.
insider_tip: Time your visit to either side of the gondola peak (10am, 1pm) — outside those windows the queue dies and the terrace tables open up. Mocktails are the safer order than full meals.
signature_address: Skyview Gondola Lower Terminal, Sanget Valley, Patnitop 182142

name: Vardaan Hotels Restaurant (Bistro)
signature_dish: Punjabi tandoori spread with valley terrace seating
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant at Vardaan Hotels Patnitop — open-air seating right next to the Skyview Gondola top station, useful for mid-range diners who want a sit-down meal between activities. Restaurant Guru ranks it #6 of 25 places to eat in Patnitop.
insider_tip: Breakfast is fixed-menu (paratha or poori-aloo) — for variety, come for lunch instead. The terrace lawn tables are unheated; pick the indoor section in winter.
signature_address: Vardaan Hotels, near Skyview Gondola Top Station, Patnitop 182142

name: Shabnam Restaurant (Hotel Green Top)
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant at Hotel Green Top — open to non-residents, one of the few sit-down dinner options in Padora Enclave. Outlook Traveller's Patnitop guide calls it a working alternative to hotel-only dining.
insider_tip: Reviews flag prices as high (chilly chicken plate ~₹800) for what you get. Cap your order at 1-2 mains and supplement with rotis — full multi-course meals don't justify the bill.
signature_address: Hotel Green Top, Padora Enclave, Patnitop 182142

name: JKTDC Hotel Alpine Restaurant
why_it_matters: The restaurant inside JKTDC's Hotel Alpine block at Patnitop's Tourist Bungalow complex — government-run, the cheapest sit-down option on the hill. Reviewers report a four-person meal totaling ~₹400. Open to non-guests.
insider_tip: The menu card is short — five or six mains and a few sides. Order the paneer kofta or biryani; both reviewers consistently call out as fresh. Food can be sent to JKTDC huts/cottages on request.
signature_address: JKTDC Tourist Bungalow Complex, National Highway 1A, Patnitop 182142

name: Krystal Hotel Restaurant
signature_dish: freshly-prepared veg/non-veg platter opposite Naag Mandir
why_it_matters: Hotel-restaurant opposite Karlah Naag Mandir, ~5 minutes from the Skyview Gondola. One of the handful of options in Padora Enclave actively serving walk-in diners; ice-cream parlour and café tucked into the same building.
insider_tip: Food is prepared fresh-to-order — reviewers consistently flag the 25-30 minute wait. Order kahwa or coffee while you wait, and avoid ordering for more than four people unless you have time.
signature_address: Opposite Naag Mandir, Karlah, Padora Enclave, Patnitop 182142

name: Garam Masala Restaurant
signature_dish: Kashmiri saag and Dogri vegetarian thali
why_it_matters: A pure-veg standalone restaurant in Padora Enclave near Naag Mandir — rare in a hotel-dominated dining scene. Listed on TripAdvisor's Patnitop top three; positioned as the dependable veg-only stop for pilgrim families on the Vaishno Devi-Patnitop circuit.
insider_tip: No alcohol, no non-veg — call ahead (+91 94191 64071) if you're a group of six-plus, since the dining room is small. Closes earlier than hotel restaurants; aim for lunch or early dinner.
signature_address: Padora Enclave, near Naag Temple, Hotel Samson, Patnitop 182142
